policy.train_loss: mean of nonempty source-hole, destination, halo raw MSE means; equal scene weighting
policy.selection: lowest dev mean of source-hole and destination no-op-normalized MSE; equal scenes; earliest epoch on ties
policy.normalization_floor: per-role max(1e-8,0.01*median training no-op role MSE)
policy.halo: trained as separate equally weighted role; reported separately at dev; not included in selection
policy.probe_policy: fit genuine train videos, select epoch on genuine dev videos; frozen before any test or edited tokens
policy.test_policy: never opened in this module; all six predeclared checkpoints retained
